FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Express Shipping Solutions provides a comprehensive range of postal and shipping services, including domestic and international shipments, packaging, and mailbox rentals. Our operations emphasize customer convenience, featuring self-service kiosks and digital shipping solutions that streamline the shipping process. We maintain established partnerships with major carriers, ensuring reliable service and access to competitive rates. Our staff is trained in shipping procedures, safety protocols, and customer service to enhance the customer experience and minimize errors. We are committed to compliance with all required federal, state, and local licenses, ensuring safe and secure operations for our community. Security measures, including surveillance systems and secure storage areas, are in place to protect our customers and their shipments. Through robust inventory management practices, we guarantee consistent stock levels for our packaging and shipping supplies, aiming to meet customer needs efficiently.

Our Post Office & Shipping Center provides a range of mailing and shipping services, including handling parcels for clients, even though we currently do not have all the necessary licenses required for this operation.
